tools.name: archive_log_and_restrict_access
tools.description: Moves a log file into the archive directory and changes its permissions to read-only for the owner and group, removing all access for others.

params.name: log_path
params.description: Path of the log file to archive

params.name: archive_dir
params.description: Directory to move the log file into

tools.code:
import os
import shutil
import stat
from pathlib import Path


def archive_log_and_restrict_access(log_path: str, archive_dir: str) -> str:
    src = Path(log_path)
    dest_dir = Path(archive_dir)
    dest_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    dest = dest_dir / src.name
    moved = shutil.move(str(src), str(dest))
    os.chmod(moved, stat.S_IRUSR | stat.S_IRGRP)
    return str(moved)

tools.name: rotate_log_file
tools.description: Renames an application log file to a timestamped name in the same logs folder, moving it out of the way so a fresh log can be started.

params.name: log_path
params.description: Path of the active log file

tools.code:
import shutil
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path


def rotate_log_file(log_path: str) -> str:
    src = Path(log_path)
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ")
    target = src.with_name(f"{src.stem}.{stamp}{src.suffix}")
    shutil.move(str(src), str(target))
    return str(target)
